outputs.explanation: Panel a shows schematic icons and micrographs illustrating image cropping/rotation; it contains no plot of averaged data.
Panel b shows schematic icons and micrographs illustrating image spacing; no plot with averages is present.
Panel c shows schematic icons and micrographs illustrating insets/zoom; no plot with averages is present.
Panel d shows a schematic min/max slider and grayscale micrographs illustrating brightness/contrast adjustment; no plot of averaged data is present.
Panel e shows schematic color-contrast icons and micrographs illustrating channel annotation; no plot with averages is present.
Panel f shows a schematic Venn-like diagram and grayscale micrographs illustrating channel separation; no plot of averaged data is present.
Panel g shows a schematic calibration scale example and micrographs with intensity/pseudocolor scale bars; these are calibration legends, not plots of averaged data with individual points.
